title: Keyturn Host Protection Plan: Appraising a Loss and Booking What Is Accepted
content:
An appraisal settles what the marketplace accepts on a loss and books that money as owed to the host. The amount the plan accepts on a loss is not settled before a claim for that loss stands opened on the enrolment at a stated amount. The appraisal stands against the claim it values on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment covering the vehicle.

### Situation of use and capability

`record_loss_appraisal_09001cb5` writes an appraisal record against the claim carrying how the loss was valued and who was found responsible, and raises the enrolment's balance owed to the host by the accepted figure. The host can afterwards see the appraisal against the claim and the higher amount owed to them on the enrolment.

### How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk agent, who establishes the accepted figure and passes it in.

### Parameters

- `enrollment_id` — the reference number of the host protection enrolment the claim is made under, read from the enrolment record retrieved for this host.
- `source_claim_id` — the reference number of the open claim record this appraisal values, read from the claim records standing on that enrolment.
- `booking_id` — the reference number of the trip booking the loss happened on, read from the claim record being appraised.
- `damage_category` — the kind of loss being appraised, one of `exterior_body`, `interior`, `glass`, `tyres_wheels`, `mechanical`, `theft_total_loss`, `missing_equipment` and `third_party_property`.
- `appraisal_channel` — how the loss was valued, one of `photo_estimate` (valued from the photographs lodged with the report alone), `in_person_adjuster` (valued by an adjuster who inspected the vehicle in person), `repair_shop_invoice` (valued from the repair work a shop has invoiced on the vehicle) and `total_loss_valuation` (valued as a write-off against the marketplace's valuation of the vehicle).
- `liability_finding` — who the marketplace found responsible for the loss, one of `undetermined`, `guest_at_fault`, `host_at_fault`, `third_party` and `no_fault`, being respectively responsibility not settled, the guest who had the vehicle, the host, someone outside the trip, and nobody at fault.
- `accepted_loss_amount` — the amount the marketplace accepts on this loss and books as owed to the host, in USD, 2 decimal places, signed, passed as a positive figure rounded half-up to the cent.

### Return

A confirmation line in plain text carrying the reference number of the appraisal record, the claim it values, the accepted amount in USD to the cent and the enrolment's new balance owed to the host. Receiving that line means the appraisal stands and the money is booked as owed; no other output is produced.
